frequency_question: How often do targeted ministry-led automotive electrification schemes successfully clear inter-ministerial consultation and launch within a 33-month window?
membership_rule: Includes central government schemes explicitly providing financial incentives, capital subsidies, or credit guarantees for commercial electric vehicles in India; excludes state-level policies and non-automotive heavy industry schemes.

cases.name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Auto and Auto Components

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; universe of major national EV/auto manufacturing incentive frameworks in this exact class is small and fully enumerated.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller sub-schemes handled purely at bureaucratic department levels without cabinet-level rollout.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 3 major comparable initiatives
validity_reason: Policy cadence and bureaucratic structures governing automotive subsidies remain stable under the current administrative framework through the decade.
